title: 第15章：促销
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
马超捏着兜里刚赚的三百多块现金，心里踏实又火热，转头就问旁边的王大爷：“大爷，现在手机多少钱一台？我这点钱，够置办一个不？”

    王大爷淡淡一笑，随口回道：“价位参差不齐，便宜的新机几百块，中端的一千往上，高端牌子机几千块都正常，一分钱一分货。”

    马超瞳孔微缩，心里猛地一沉：“这么贵？”

    方才赚下三百多，他还暗自窃喜，觉得自己瞬间脱贫，手握巨款，底气十足。毕竟在1985年的小乡村，三百块妥妥是普通人一年都挣不到的巨款。

    可放到这个繁华现世，这点钱根本不值一提，连个像样的手机都买不起。

    巨大的落差瞬间浇灭了他心头的得意，让他瞬间认清了现实。

    王大爷一眼看穿他的窘迫，笑着宽慰：“没必要非得买新机，二手的完全够用。街上手机店遍地都是，成色不错的二手机也就两三百，打电话、扫码收款样样行，性价比拉满。”

    马超眼前一亮，当即拱手道谢：“多谢大爷提点！”

    两三百！刚好卡在他的预算里！这个路子，他死死记在了心里。

    又闲聊两句，天色彻底大亮，清晨的早市渐渐散场。人流褪去，摊贩们纷纷收拾摊位收工，王大爷也打理好东西，跟马超挥手道别，转身离去。

    马超抬手死死按住贴身口袋，确认一沓现金安稳无误，没有半点松动。
content_en:
Ma Chao held the more than 300 yuan in cash he had just earned in his pocket, feeling secure and hot in his heart. He turned around and asked Uncle Wang next to him: "Uncle, how much does a mobile phone cost now? Is my little money enough to buy one?"

    Uncle Wang smiled faintly and replied casually: "Prices vary. A cheap new phone costs a few hundred yuan, a mid-range one costs upwards of a thousand, and a high-end brand phone costs several thousand. You get what you pay for."

    Ma Chao's pupils shrank, and his heart suddenly sank: "Is it so expensive?"

    Having just earned more than 300 yuan, he secretly rejoiced, feeling that he had escaped poverty in an instant, with a huge sum of money in his hands, and he was full of confidence. After all, in a small rural area in 1985, three hundred yuan was a huge amount of money that ordinary people could not earn in a year.

    But in this prosperous world, this amount of money is not worth mentioning at all. You can't even afford a decent mobile phone.

    The huge gap instantly extinguished his pride and made him realize the reality instantly.

    Uncle Wang saw through his embarrassment at a glance and comforted him with a smile: "There is no need to buy a new phone, second-hand ones are enough. There are mobile phone stores all over the street, and good-quality second-hand phones only cost two or three hundred. They can make calls, scan QR codes to collect money, and are very cost-effective."

    Ma Chao's eyes lit up, and he immediately handed over his hands and thanked him: "Thank you for the tip!"

    Two or three hundred! It just fit in his budget! He remembered this route firmly in his heart.

    After chatting for a few more words, the sky was completely bright and the early morning market gradually ended. The crowds of people subsided and the vendors packed up their stalls to finish work. Uncle Wang also took care of his things, waved goodbye to Ma Chao, and turned to leave.

    Ma Chao raised his hand and pressed firmly on his pocket, making sure that the stack of cash was secure and not loose at all.
